answer: A task market can issue one nontransferable work ticket per epoch, binding an agent key to a data slice and a random challenge. Before payment, validators recompute the result and compare signed samples with an independent source; duplicate slices, reused tickets, or mismatched hashes create slashable evidence. copper, prism, and jade label this epoch and enter the signature. Creating n aliases then requires n deposits and n distinct verifiable jobs, so copied keys add no reward.
